responsibility: This header is the D-front-end glue layer for the AArch64 port. It declares the AArch64 D hook implementations defined in aarch64-d.cc and binds them to the D target hook macros so that the D front end uses AArch64-specific CPU version registration and target-info reporting.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration and macro-binding half of the aarch64-d pair: it exposes the AArch64 D hook entry points and assigns them to TARGET_D_* macros, while aarch64-d.cc provides the executable hook logic.
